C1489.title: Detecting Eclipse Attacks Inside TEE
C1489.summary: This study proposes a method for reliably detecting extended eclipse attacks even when the attacker controls all network connections. By monitoring difficulty parameter changes in proof-of-work protocols, the algorithm detects suppression of new blocks and attacker attempts to force enclave clients onto a malicious fork by lowering the difficulty.

references.title: Am I Eclipsed? A Smart Detector of Eclipse Attacks for Ethereum
